definitions.explanation: A round neckline that sits close around the base of the neck, as on most T-shirts and sweatshirts. Also a garment with this neckline.

examples.japanese: クルーネック⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧。
⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧クルーネック⟦の→の：09472_no⟧Tシャツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a white crew-neck T-shirt.

examples.japanese: クルーネック⟦と→と：00512_to⟧Vネック⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{迷|まよ}った→迷う：02426_mayou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{首元|くびもと}→首元：24294_kubimoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すっきり→すっきり：05180_sukkiri⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧ほう⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't decide between a crew neck and a V-neck, but chose the one that makes the neckline look neater.

notes:
From English "crew neck." Common in shop listings and fashion writing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{丸首|まるくび}→丸首：33918_marukubi⟧: round neck — the native word for the same neckline
- Vネック: V-neck
- ⟦タートルネック→タートルネック：27713_taatorunekku⟧: turtleneck
